Name: Blahaj Redux
Author: KaileyStardew
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/fdwG71XV/separator.png[/img][/center]

Adds blåhaj furniture in two sizes and twelve colours. Includes special blåhaj that match the Wizard Catalogue, Retro Catalogue, Junimo Catalogue, and Joja Catalogue. This is a complete remake of my original Blåhaj pack, which was deprecated alongside DGA.

Blåhaj can be purchased from Robin on Saturdays and Sundays. Certain blåhaj can also be acquired from Krobus, Joja Mart, and the furniture catalogues. Fully configurable.

All Blåhaj can be configured between the default colour scheme and a desaturated one. The Wizard and Retro blåhaj have configurable alternative colour schemes to match recolours of their respective catalogues. 

If you have Calcifer, a Blåhaj Catalogue containing every blåhaj will be sold at Robin's shop.

[left]Appearance Section:[/left]
[list]
[*][b]General Colour Scheme:[/b] Vanilla, desaturated. Tone down the colour scheme.[/*]
[*][b]Catalogue Colour: [/b]Several options. Control the colour palette of the Catalogue. The Catalogue is only available if you have Calcifer.[/*]
[*][b]Wizard Catalogue Colour Scheme:[/b] False, lilac, green, black. Alternate colour schemes for if you play with a mod that recolours the Wizard Catalogue. If set to false, the wizard blåhaj will match the general colour scheme setting.[/*]
[*][b]Retro Catalogue Colour Scheme: [/b]False, teal, navy. Alternate colour schemes for if you play with a mod that recolours the Retro Catalogue. If set to false, the retro blåhaj will match the general colour scheme setting.[/*]
[/list]Shop Section:
[list]
[*][b]Carpenter:[/b] true, false. Robin will sell a random Blåhaj on Saturdays, and a random Smolhaj on Sundays.[/*]
[*][b]Krobus: [/b]true, false. Krobus will sell a Voidhaj on Saturdays, and a Smolvoidhaj on Sundays.[/*]
[*][b]Joja Mart: [/b]true, false. Jojamart will sell a Jojahaj or Smoljojahaj  every day.[/*]
[*][b]Special Catalogues: [/b]true, false. The Junimo Catalogue, Wizard Catalogue, Retro Catalogue, and Joja Catalogue will have themed Blåhaj & Smolhaj available.[/*]
[*][b]Fishable Blahaj: [/b]true, false. Add Blahaj as a rare fishing catch at the beach (all seasons).[/*]
[/list][center]
